title: Apply to register an item of plant
summary: This page provides information on how to apply to register certain items of plant with SafeWork NSW or a corresponding WHS regulator.
intro:
Certain items of plant must be registered with SafeWork NSW or a corresponding work health and safety (WHS) regulator before they're permitted to be used.

Registration ensures the item has been:

Mobile item(s) of plant coming into NSW do not require registration if they are currently registered with the WHS regulator in their jurisdiction.

Note: An item of plant's registration must be renewed annually, and before it expires. Visit Apply to renew the registration of an item of plant for more information.
who_can_apply: Boilers and pressure vessels categorized as hazard level A, B or C according to criteria in Section 2.1 of AS 4343, with some exceptions.
Tower cranes, including self-erecting tower cranes.
Mobile cranes with a rated capacity of greater than 10 tonnes.
Amusement devices classified by Section 2.1 of AS 3533, with some exceptions.
The person with management or control of the plant (such as the owner or lessee) must register the item of plant once it has been deemed safe to operate by a competent person.
Plant items that require registration include those detailed in the Work Health and Safety Regulation 2025.
what_you_need: Design registration and plant item specifications.
Payment (a fee is required for the registration of each item of plant).
If you have multiple items at one location, you may receive a reduced fee if they are lodged at the same time and owned by the same applicant.
It is recommended to email licensing@safework.nsw.gov.au with your plant item details and location to align registration dates and qualify for a discounted renewal fee next year.

how_to_steps.text: Your fee will be calculated on completion of the online application.
Submit your application with the required payment.

faqs.q: Do all items of plant require registration?
faqs.a: No, mobile items of plant coming into NSW do not require registration if they are currently registered with the WHS regulator in their jurisdiction.

faqs.q: How often must an item of plant be registered?
faqs.a: An item of plant's registration must be renewed annually, and before it expires.

faqs.q: Who must register the item of plant?
faqs.a: The person with management or control of the plant, such as the owner or lessee, must register the item of plant once it has been deemed safe to operate by a competent person.
